summary: Join our Public Sector Auditing Training Course. Learn best practices and techniques to excel in auditing within government and public organizations.
lede: Public sector auditing examines financial and operational activity to assess controls, compliance, and the use of public resources. For government auditors, compliance officers, and performance audit managers, this training covers risk-based planning, internal-control testing, and audit reporting. Participants also work on performance and value-for-money assessment, procurement fraud indicators, and computer-assisted techniques for analyzing public data.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is engineered for professionals responsible for oversight, compliance, and performance evaluation within government and public sector entities.
modules: Performance Auditing and Value for Money
Data Analytics and AI in Government Audits
Fraud Detection and Public Procurement Audits
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of basic auditing principles, internal controls, or public administration workflows. No advanced coding experience is required for the data analytics modules, as all exercises utilize accessible, pre-configured tools and templates.
